open_blocking.title: Criterion 3 not met: removing a fail-closed evidence or parse check turns a denial into ADMITTED or accepted, and no test fails
open_blocking.evidence: I ran mutations on a scratch copy of worker/src/providerDispatchEnvelope.ts at 61e0e2a, restored it after each run, and reran `npx vitest run worker/src/providerDispatchEnvelope.test.ts`. Each of these mutants leaves the suite at 129/129 passed. (a) Dropping `typeof enabled !== "boolean" ||` in classifyRollout (line 731): with rollout.enabled set to "yes" or 1, the original returns current_evidence_malformed and the mutant returns {admitted:true, envelopeFingerprint:f3e0cb1f...e4cb}. (b) Dropping `isStringArray(value.supported_processes)` in isWellFormedAdmission (line 667): with supported_processes ["cnc_milling",42], the original returns admission_evidence_malformed and the mutant returns admitted:true. (c) Dropping `isStringArray(value.accepted_file_extensions)` (line 668): with accepted_file_extensions [42], the original returns admission_evidence_malformed and the mutant returns admitted:true. The shared admission check never reads this array, so this check is the only guard. (d) Dropping `if (!files.some((file) => file.role === "cad")) deny();` in parseOutboundFiles (line 292): a drawing-only outboundFiles is denied as envelope_malformed by the original and accepted as ok:true by the mutant. ARCHITECTURE.md states the outbound set must contain the cad file. The fixture has no row for a non-boolean rollout.enabled, a non-string array element, or a drawing-only outbound set; the evidence rows `rollout capability` and `rollout extra key` do not exercise (a). The PR body ticks criterion 3 and says the mutation sweep is covered. Round 2 treated this same class of finding as blocking.
open_blocking.suggested_fix: Add fixture rows. evidenceDenials: rollout.enabled "yes" -> current_evidence_malformed; admission.supported_processes ["cnc_milling",42] -> admission_evidence_malformed; admission.accepted_file_extensions [42] -> admission_evidence_malformed. malformed: outboundFiles holding only the drawing entry (set outboundFiles to [drawing outbound]) -> envelope_malformed. Rerun the mutants to confirm each new row kills exactly its mutant, then update the criterion 3 text in the PR body.
